notes: Built from ep009.ts lines: only CAPITALS added; words identical to say.
persona: You are an energetic, charismatic YouTuber narrating a vertical short video, talking straight to one friend whose house is about to be buried. Conversational, expressive, a little mischievous and amazed, with natural breaths. Change your speed, pitch, emphasis and rhythm with what is happening: an urgent hook, a teasing fake calm, escalation that climbs line by line (a little faster and bigger each time), a huge punch on the million tonnes, wonder at the scale, then a sly, mind-blown reveal for the twist and a warm, friendly call to action. Words in CAPITALS get extra emphasis. Each line starts with a direction in parentheses: follow it, but never read the directions aloud. Keep a brisk, punchy pace throughout, about 175 words per minute: no long pauses inside a line.

lines.style: urgent and quick, right in your ear, hit the number hard
lines.tagged: One TRILLION dollar bills are falling on your house. Right NOW.
Each one weighs about a GRAM. Harmless, right?
WRONG. Soon a Statue of Liberty's weight sits on your ROOF.
Your roof caves IN. Then your WALLS.

lines.style: bigger, amazed, clear on the number
lines.tagged: Eleven THOUSAND tonnes. More than the WHOLE Eiffel Tower.

lines.style: urgent, ominous on the last words
lines.tagged: Your whole street DISAPPEARS. And it keeps FALLING.

lines.style: huge and slow, the climax, a dramatic punch
lines.tagged: One MILLION tonnes. Heavier than TWO Empire State Buildings.

lines.style: wide-eyed wonder, brisk; say packed and tight as two crisp, clearly separate words
lines.tagged: Packed tight, your cash is BIGGER than that whole building.
Spread over a square kilometre, it's STILL over a metre deep.
Stacked, it climbs over a hundred THOUSAND kilometres. Past every GPS satellite.

lines.style: leaning in, sly, building suspense, trailing off
lines.tagged: Here's the TWIST. Every REAL dollar bill in circulation, about fifteen billion...
would cover less than TWO percent of your pile.
Your trillion dollar bills don't even EXIST.
What should you survive next? The BEST comment becomes the next video.
